tools.name: get_interview_guide
tools.description: Returns the interview guide: which questions to ask the user, default values, engine limits and the exact format of the 8 input files. Call this first.

tools.name: validate_input
tools.description: Checks the 8 input files in a few seconds without creating a timetable: file structure, engine limits and a capacity analysis (enough teachers/time?). Returns VALID (with warnings) or INVALID (with reasons). Always run this before create_schedule.

tools.name: create_schedule
tools.description: Starts calculating the full timetable from the 8 input files (validate them first). Returns a job_id at once; the calculation takes about 5-8 minutes. Then keep calling get_schedule_result with the job_id in the same reply until it is done.

tools.name: get_schedule_result
tools.description: Gets the status or result of a job from create_schedule (or a slow validate_input). While running: progress. When done: a compact timetable as text plus a link (valid 1 hour) to the full JSON result. view='classes' (default) = one table per class, 'teachers' = one per teacher incl. preparation time,

tools.name: send_feedback
tools.description: Passes the user's feedback about the timetable service on to its developer (what worked, what did not, wishes).
